messages:
Sam (People Ops): Heads-up: Ravi Patel (Backend / infra candidate) accepted onsite + remote loop for week of May 27. Need to lock panel, arrange loaner Windows laptop + ethernet dongle, ensure wheelchair-accessible route to lobby, and decide on travel reimbursement (parking or rideshare). Any conflicts?

Priya (Hiring Manager): Prefer Tue morning 9:3011:30 PT to keep interviews consecutive. Can shift if someone can't.

Diego (Interviewer): Tue morning is OK for me but I have a 10:30 standup; can we avoid 10:1510:45? Otherwise I can cover earlier.

Kira (Scheduler): Candidate availability from email: Mon all day remote, Tue 92, Thu 1. She (Ravi) will be flying in Mon night. Requests: ground-floor meeting room, quick charger, and note re: wheelchair access.

Sam (People Ops): If Ravi arrives Monday night, offering Tue 9:30 keeps things tight. Kira — can you build a 2.5h loop with a 30m buffer for arrival/tech check?

Kira (Scheduler): Draft schedule:
Tue May 28
09:3009:45  Welcome + tech check (Lobby A / Zoom)
09:4510:30  Interview 1 (Priya)
10:3011:15  Interview 2 (Diego)
11:1511:45  Debrief + next steps
Notes: ground-floor room reserved, wheelchair route noted, loaner Win laptop + ethernet ready. I'll send invite after confirmation.

Jonah (Office Admin): Confirmed ground-floor room (Lobby A) and I put a loaner Surface Book on hold with ethernet adapter and spare charger. I'll also reserve an accessible parking spot by request.

Priya (Hiring Manager): We'll reimburse rideshare up to $60; parking pass ok but rideshare better for arrival assistance. Approve rideshare.

Sam (People Ops): Approve rideshare. Jonah, please set up a prepaid code or rideshare voucher. Kira, include travel reimbursement instructions in the invite.

Jonah (Office Admin): Rideshare voucher initiated. I'll DM Ravi the pickup code and door buzzer instructions. Also will place a volunteer escort at the lobby 20min before start.

Diego (Interviewer): FYI I'll take interview 2 and will be remote for the first 15min because of a doc review; have Slack open to join quickly.

Kira (Scheduler): Noted. I'll add a 10min overlap between 1 and 2 for Diego's remote join + handoff. Sending invites now. :white_check_mark:

Sam (People Ops): Thanks all  closing thread unless anything urgent pops up.
